annotations.title: UK company accounts — headline financials (Companies House)

description: Headline figures from the accounts UK companies file electronically at Companies House, one record per company and balance-sheet date: net assets (negative = net liabilities) with the tag it was read from, cash at bank, creditors due within one year, average employees, the dormant flag, turnover and profit where filed (few small companies file them), and the same figures for the prior period. From the official daily Accounts Data Product (iXBRL), read every morning; the register builds up from 2026-11 onward. Organisation-level numbers only — directors, signatories and narrative notes are never ingested. Filters combine with AND; q searches all text fields. Costs 1 credit(s) per call with an API key; without one, a preview of up to 5 rows (20 calls/day).
